_about: Tool-agnostic reality-grounding anchors for a pharma ROI / rNPV tool (RA / inflammation & autoimmunity, US-centric). Ported without widening bands from rNPV Copilot commit fca049d. Each anchor checks a live model output or a separately reported configuration value against a cited band.
_bands: expected = [lo, hi]; hi = 1e18 means an open upper bound (>lo).

anchors.measure: cumulative probability of technical+regulatory success (LOA) from Phase 1 to approval for an AUTOIMMUNE asset = product of the four phase-transition probabilities (P1->2 x P2->3 x P3->NDA x NDA->appr)
anchors.claim: Autoimmune LOA from Phase 1 = 10.7% (0.552 x 0.314 x 0.653 x 0.941)
anchors.source: BIO / Biomedtracker / QLS, Clinical Development Success Rates 2011-2020, Fig 2

anchors.measure: US RA advanced-therapy-eligible addressable patients = adult_pop x prevalence x diagnosed x treated x eligible(moderate-severe, b/tsDMARD-eligible)
anchors.claim: US RA advanced-therapy pool ~300k-560k (~1.3M diagnosed x 25-45% b/tsDMARD-eligible)
anchors.source: GBD/CDC RA adult prevalence ~0.5-1%; Adelphi RWE b/tsDMARD utilization

anchors.measure: mean years a starting patient remains ON a chronic I&I therapy = integral of the on-treatment survival curve (persistence), for a moderate-persistence route
anchors.claim: Mean time on therapy ~3.0-5.2y (anti-TNF median persistence 3.3-3.8y; 1L TNFi mean ~5.35y)
anchors.source: Pombo-Suarez et al. 2015 (RA anti-TNF persistence); Rhumadata registry

anchors.measure: modeled annual NET price (post-rebate, NOT WAC) for an ORAL advanced-therapy RA drug
anchors.claim: Oral advanced-therapy NET price ~$18k-40k/yr (below biologic WAC; net != WAC)
anchors.source: SSR Health SEC-rebate-derived nets: adalimumab ~$27-30k, tofacitinib ~$30k, upadacitinib ~$33-45k (WAC ~$83k)

anchors.measure: small-molecule per-patient annual COGS as a FRACTION of annual net revenue, for a representative drug-like NCE (NOT aspirin)
anchors.claim: Small-molecule API COGS is a trivial share of revenue -> <8% of net (gross margin >92%)
anchors.source: BioProcess Intl — branded small-molecule COGS <5-10% of sales

anchors.measure: peptide per-patient annual COGS (small-scale SPPS cost model), for a ~20-mer at a mid dose; must be materially > small-molecule but bounded
anchors.claim: Peptide per-patient COGS ~$3k-60k/yr (small-scale SPPS; >> small-mol, but bounded)

anchors.measure: ratio of the tool's PEPTIDE probability-of-success factor to its SMALL-MOLECULE factor
anchors.claim: Peptide/small-molecule LOA ratio ~1.03-1.12 (BIO Fig 10b: peptide 8.0% / small-molecule 7.5% = 1.067). Do NOT use the FDA-classification table (NME 5.7% / Biologic 9.1%) for a small-mol-vs-peptide axis.
anchors.source: BIO / Biomedtracker / QLS 2011-2020, Fig 10b (biochemical modality LOA)

anchors.measure: the HEADLINE risk-adjusted NPV (eNPV) the tool ships, for a de-risked Phase-3 RA single-indication small-molecule asset (order of magnitude only)
anchors.claim: eNPV of a de-risked Phase-3 RA single-indication asset lands in $30M-$3.5B (order-of-magnitude external anchor; wide by nature)
anchors.source: single-asset RA advanced-therapy rNPV / deal-comp range (soft anchor — no clean public single-asset dataset)

anchors.measure: cumulative autoimmune LOA from Phase 1 (same measure as pos_loa_chain), checked against a band spanned by TWO INDEPENDENT datasets
anchors.claim: Autoimmune LOA sits within the range bracketed by two independent estimates: BIO 10.7% and Wong-Siah-Lo 2019 (overall 13.8%, immunology higher)
anchors.source: BIO 2011-2020 (10.7%) AND Wong, Siah & Lo 2019, Biostatistics 20(2):273 (13.8% overall)

anchors.measure: FALSIFICATION CONTROL: run the addressable-population computation with prevalence multiplied by 10x; the result MUST exceed the addressable_us upper bound (560k). If it does not, your bands are unfalsifiable.
anchors.claim: A 10x prevalence corruption MUST breach the addressable band ceiling (proves bands can fail)

anchors.measure: the IRA Medicare MFP-price-effect year the tool uses for a small-molecule / NDA asset
anchors.claim: IRA MFP price takes effect 9 years post-approval for small molecules / NDAs (selection at 7y)

anchors.measure: the IRA Medicare MFP-price-effect year the tool uses for a biologic / BLA asset
anchors.claim: IRA MFP price takes effect 13 years post-approval for biologics / BLAs (selection at 11y). NOTE: the clock follows the APPROVAL PATHWAY, not chemistry — a synthetic peptide filed as an NDA gets 9y.

anchors.measure: the rNPV discount rate the tool uses
anchors.claim: rNPV discount rate is a house CONVENTION of ~10-12% (risk lives in the PoS weights). It is NOT an empirical fact; stage-dependent WACC ranges 8-20% and a pure-rNPV school uses near-risk-free 3-5%.
anchors.source: Alacrita, 'Valuing Pharmaceutical Assets: When to Use NPV vs rNPV'

anchors.measure: the per-phase Phase-3 out-of-pocket trial cost input the tool uses for a small molecule
anchors.claim: Phase-3 out-of-pocket cost ~$245.8M (small molecule). Do NOT use the $2.6B capitalized-per-approved-drug figure per-asset (it already includes attrition + cost of capital your PoS chain models).
anchors.source: DiMasi, Grabowski & Hansen 2016, J Health Econ (Tufts CSDD)
